Painting Work Order.Interior Work: Repaint living room, dining room, and hallway (approx. 1,200 sq ft). Patch cracks and hairline seams, skim-coat where needed, apply two coats of premium low-VOC eggshell on walls and semi-gloss on trim and doors. Remove and reinstall outlet/switch covers; minor door touch-ups included.
Painting Work Order.Exterior Work: Repaint front façade and rear deck railings (approx. 800 sq ft). Pressure wash surfaces, spot-prime weather-damaged wood, treat rust on metal fixtures, and apply two coats of exterior acrylic latex paint. Deck boards will be stained where specified.
Painting Work Order.Materials: Premium low-VOC interior eggshell and semi-gloss paints, exterior acrylic latex, exterior primer, wood filler, exterior caulk, sandpaper, masking tape, drop cloths, brushes, rollers, stain for deck, rust inhibitor, protective PPE.
Painting Work Order.Required: On-site access to water and 120V power, parking permit for two work vehicles, homeowner approval of color swatches prior to start, city exterior painting permit if applicable, adherence to lead-safe work practices for pre-1978 properties.
Painting Work Order.Estimate:: USD 4,850.00 (includes labor, materials, surface preparation; excludes major structural repairs, hazardous-material abatement, and any required permit fees).
